questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep or long hill ahead. The hill may have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is illegal and unsafe to turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
Only stop to yield to other traffic.
Vehicles will be entering the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A flashing red traffic light means the same as a stop sign. You must stop completely, let crossing traffic and pedestrians pass, then proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers of a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right, then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line, or before the crosswalk, or before the intersection if you can see oncoming traffic. Only proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about low clearance. It shows how much space is available between the road and the bridge or overpass above it (in this case, 12 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve to the right first, then curve to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light is about to change to red.
The traffic light is about to change to green.
Stop and wait for traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: The traffic light is about to change to red.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light warns that the signal is about to turn red. Slow down and stop before the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are already in the intersection, continue through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells drivers to slow down for a sharp turn in the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mark school zones or school crossings. Watch for children and follow the speed limits posted in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: Orange warning signs indicate road work is coming. Stay alert and follow any temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards. Orange color indicates construction or maintenance work ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign blocks entry on one-way streets and roads. You may see it if you try to enter an expressway ramp going the wrong direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that wet pavement is slippery and dangerous. You may lose control of your vehicle. Slow down when you see this sign because it takes longer to stop on wet roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This round sign warns you that railroad tracks are ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway. You are about to enter a two-way highway where traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that you are leaving a one-way highway and entering a two-way highway where traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road splits into two paths. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. Right turns are not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards ahead. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.
